lovable.oewn-01462344-a.label: positive

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

lovable.oewn-01462344-a.tone: The family's plain baseline - it says the thing has whatever draws love, without dressing the quality up as innocence or sweetness.

loveable.oewn-01462344-a.label: positive

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

loveable.oewn-01462344-a.tone: The full-spelt form, identical in warmth and force to *lovable*.

adorable.oewn-01462677-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

adorable.oewn-01462677-s.tone: Superlative where *lovable* is merely descriptive - affection is not attracted but compelled, and the childlike or naive streak is what compels it.

endearing.oewn-01462677-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

endearing.oewn-01462677-s.tone: Puts the effect in motion rather than the quality at rest: it wins affection over, where *adorable* simply announces the winning is done.

lovely.oewn-01462677-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

lovely.oewn-01462677-s.tone: Broad, easy warmth for the same childlike appeal, without the surrender *adorable* implies.

angelic.oewn-01462871-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

angelic.oewn-01462871-s.tone: Lifts sweetness to an ideal - praise that leaves no room for a fault in the nature described.

angelical.oewn-01462871-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

angelical.oewn-01462871-s.tone: The extended form of *angelic*, reaching for the same unblemished sweetness with a more formal ring.

cherubic.oewn-01462871-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

cherubic.oewn-01462871-s.tone: Takes the cherub rather than the angel: sweetness that is small, round and fond instead of exalted.

seraphic.oewn-01462871-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

seraphic.oewn-01462871-s.tone: The most rarefied of the angel words - sweetness raised to something radiant and remote, well past the homely warmth of *cherubic*.

sweet.oewn-01462871-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

sweet.oewn-01462871-s.tone: The unadorned name for the nature the angel words put wings on - the same quality with none of the exaltation.

cuddlesome.oewn-01463188-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

cuddlesome.oewn-01463188-s.tone: Carries the invitation in its build - a thing that asks to be held, stated more deliberately than *cuddly*.

cuddly.oewn-01463188-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth loving → irresistibly sweet

cuddly.oewn-01463188-s.tone: Soft, offhand and physical: the appeal is being huggable, not being good-natured as in *sweet*.

becoming.oewn-01884969-s.label: positive

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

becoming.oewn-01884969-s.tone: Warm approval - what accords with custom is credited with grace rather than mere compliance, unlike the dry *decorous*.

comely.oewn-01884969-s.label: positive

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

comely.oewn-01884969-s.tone: Gentle and pleased - it finds conduct agreeable in its accord with propriety rather than measuring it against a rule.

comme_il_faut.oewn-01884969-s.label: positive

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

comme_il_faut.oewn-01884969-s.tone: A phrase rather than a word, and formal to the point of ceremony - approval delivered by invoking the code instead of describing the conduct.

decorous.oewn-01884969-s.label: positive

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

decorous.oewn-01884969-s.tone: Cool and external - conduct is held up against a standard of propriety and passes, with none of the warmth of *becoming*.

seemly.oewn-01884969-s.label: positive

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

seemly.oewn-01884969-s.tone: Understated - grants that conduct accords with propriety without the ceremony *decorous* brings to the same verdict.

correct.oewn-01885314-s.label: positive

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

correct.oewn-01885314-s.tone: Approval as a verdict - the social rule was met, and nothing warmer than that is claimed.

right.oewn-01885314-s.label: positive

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

right.oewn-01885314-s.tone: The bluntest way to render the same social judgement as *correct*, carrying no formality at all.

fitting.oewn-01885720-s.label: positive

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

fitting.oewn-01885720-s.tone: Approval keyed to the occasion and the people in it rather than to any code - it praises harmony where *correct* praises compliance.

decent.oewn-01885720-s.label: positive

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

decent.oewn-01885720-s.tone: Modest and human - it grants that a thing suits the persons and the moment, with less deliberation than *fitting*.

halal.oewn-01885994-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

halal.oewn-01885994-s.tone: A designation rather than a compliment - it states that something is proper or legitimate under a named law, and the approval belongs to that law and not to the speaker.

kosher.oewn-01886153-s.label: positive

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

kosher.oewn-01886153-s.tone: Informal and reassuring - declares a thing proper or legitimate, above board and open to no objection.

priggish.oewn-01886245-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

priggish.oewn-01886245-s.tone: Contemptuous - the excess of propriety is read as self-satisfaction, correctness worn as superiority over others.

prim.oewn-01886245-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

prim.oewn-01886245-s.tone: The lightest fault in this group - propriety held so tightly it stiffens, mocked rather than condemned.

prissy.oewn-01886245-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

prissy.oewn-01886245-s.tone: Dismissive and faintly ridiculing - the overdone propriety is treated as fussiness, silly rather than severe like *priggish*.

prudish.oewn-01886245-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly suitable → propriety pushed past its purpose

prudish.oewn-01886245-s.tone: Propriety inflated into squeamishness - more disapproving than *prim*, since the excess is taken as a readiness to be shocked.

contemptible.oewn-00907770-a.label: negative

family.axis: dismissed as worthless or half-pitied → contemptible in the most absolute degree

contemptible.oewn-00907770-a.tone: The family's plain verdict: it states that scorn is deserved without supplying any of the scorn itself, where *scummy* supplies nothing else.

abject.oewn-00907967-s.label: negative

family.axis: dismissed as worthless or half-pitied → contemptible in the most absolute degree

abject.oewn-00907967-s.tone: Formal and absolute, it puts the thing at the very floor of the scale with none of *low-down*'s sneer.

low.oewn-00907967-s.label: negative

family.axis: dismissed as worthless or half-pitied → contemptible in the most absolute degree

low.oewn-00907967-s.tone: One blunt syllable for the bottom of the scale, carrying the direction of the fall and nothing more.

low-down.oewn-00907967-s.label: negative

family.axis: dismissed as worthless or half-pitied → contemptible in the most absolute degree

low-down.oewn-00907967-s.tone: Informal, and the trailing particle adds a drawled contempt that flat *low* leaves out.

miserable.oewn-00907967-s.label: negative

family.axis: dismissed as worthless or half-pitied → contemptible in the most absolute degree

miserable.oewn-00907967-s.tone: Contempt with wretchedness folded into it, so the thing comes off squalid as well as low.

scummy.oewn-00907967-s.label: negative

family.axis: dismissed as worthless or half-pitied → contemptible in the most absolute degree

scummy.oewn-00907967-s.tone: The most physically disgusted of these, treating the utterly contemptible as filth you would rather not touch.

scurvy.oewn-00907967-s.label: negative

family.axis: dismissed as worthless or half-pitied → contemptible in the most absolute degree

scurvy.oewn-00907967-s.tone: Comes out as a curse rather than an assessment, the contempt thrown instead of delivered.

mean.oewn-00908261-s.label: negative

family.axis: dismissed as worthless or half-pitied → contemptible in the most absolute degree

mean.oewn-00908261-s.tone: Writes a thing off as amounting to nothing, a dismissal by worthlessness rather than the earned scorn of *contemptible*.

pathetic.oewn-00908403-s.label: negative

family.axis: dismissed as worthless or half-pitied → contemptible in the most absolute degree

pathetic.oewn-00908403-s.tone: Contempt leads and pity trails: the scorn is the louder half of the mixture.

pitiable.oewn-00908403-s.label: negative

family.axis: dismissed as worthless or half-pitied → contemptible in the most absolute degree

pitiable.oewn-00908403-s.tone: The gentler face of the same mixed response, letting the pity carry the weight the contempt in *pathetic* takes.

pitiful.oewn-00908403-s.label: negative

family.axis: dismissed as worthless or half-pitied → contemptible in the most absolute degree

pitiful.oewn-00908403-s.tone: Holds both halves at once, asking you to feel sorry for the thing and look down on it in the same breath.

wicked.oewn-02523798-a.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

wicked.oewn-02523798-a.tone: The plain, unhedged moral verdict, and it covers both the settled principle and the actual practice rather than choosing between them.

evil.oewn-02524157-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

evil.oewn-02524157-s.tone: Names the thing as vice itself rather than describing a fault in it, which makes it absolute where *wicked* is merely damning.

vicious.oewn-02524157-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

vicious.oewn-02524157-s.tone: Presents vice as the settled bent of the thing, so it sounds like a diagnosis of character beside *evil*'s flat sentence.

heavy.oewn-02524297-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

heavy.oewn-02524297-s.tone: A casting word: it marks the villain's part, or the actor filling it, and condemns nobody.

flagitious.oewn-02524438-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

flagitious.oewn-02524438-s.tone: Formal and heavy-syllabled, delivering the same extreme-and-criminal verdict as *heinous* in a more elevated register.

heinous.oewn-02524438-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

heinous.oewn-02524438-s.tone: The blunt public condemnation, wickedness pitched so far into the criminal that the word works almost as a sentence.

iniquitous.oewn-02524601-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

iniquitous.oewn-02524601-s.tone: The gravest of its group, weighing the wrong as an enormity rather than simply logging it as sin like *sinful*.

sinful.oewn-02524601-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

sinful.oewn-02524601-s.tone: The plainest naming of wickedness-as-sin, condemnatory without the swell of *iniquitous*.

ungodly.oewn-02524601-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

ungodly.oewn-02524601-s.tone: Measures the wickedness as distance from godliness, so the fault is a standing away rather than *sinful*'s committed offence.

irreclaimable.oewn-02524877-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

irreclaimable.oewn-02524877-s.tone: Pictures reform as recovery and denies it — nothing here can be got back.

irredeemable.oewn-02524877-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

irredeemable.oewn-02524877-s.tone: The heaviest of these four, since redemption is what it withholds: a final verdict rather than a prognosis.

unredeemable.oewn-02524877-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

unredeemable.oewn-02524877-s.tone: The same refusal built on a blunt negative prefix, more workaday in sound than *irredeemable*.

unreformable.oewn-02524877-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

unreformable.oewn-02524877-s.tone: The flattest of the group, stating only that reform will not take, with none of *irredeemable*'s note of lost salvation.

nefarious.oewn-02525059-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

nefarious.oewn-02525059-s.tone: Condemns the wickedness in the abstract, where *villainous* points instead at the one committing it.

villainous.oewn-02525059-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

villainous.oewn-02525059-s.tone: Casts the extreme wickedness as a villain's, making it a fact of character rather than of the deed.

peccable.oewn-02525272-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely liable to sin → wicked past any reform

peccable.oewn-02525272-s.tone: The mildest here by a wide margin: it concedes only that sin is possible, not that any has been done.

invigorating.oewn-01359531-a.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

invigorating.oewn-01359531-a.tone: The plain, full-strength word for the effect, and the only one here that promises strength as well as liveliness, where *enlivening* offers spirit alone.

animating.oewn-01359780-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

animating.oewn-01359780-s.tone: Warm approval aimed at spirit rather than muscle - what it gives is vivacity, not the strength *invigorating* claims.

enlivening.oewn-01359780-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

enlivening.oewn-01359780-s.tone: The same gift of spirit as *animating*, but framed as a lift applied to something that was flat before.

bracing.oewn-01359875-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

bracing.oewn-01359875-s.tone: Approval with a bite in it - the energy arrives sharply, where *refreshing* delivers the same energy gently.

brisk.oewn-01359875-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

brisk.oewn-01359875-s.tone: Mild and matter-of-fact praise that renders vitality as pace and snap rather than as depth of force.

fresh.oewn-01359875-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

fresh.oewn-01359875-s.tone: The simplest word in the group for this energy, crediting clarity and cleanness with the lift that *bracing* wins by sharpness.

refreshing.oewn-01359875-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

refreshing.oewn-01359875-s.tone: Easy, grateful approval - the energy it names reads as relief from tiredness rather than as a charge of power.

refreshful.oewn-01359875-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

refreshful.oewn-01359875-s.tone: Identical in force to *refreshing* but stiffer in build, which lends the same lift a formal weight.

tonic.oewn-01359875-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

tonic.oewn-01359875-s.tone: Cool, measured approval that credits a thing with steadying and energizing rather than delighting, unlike the showier *exhilarating*.

exhilarating.oewn-01360190-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

exhilarating.oewn-01360190-s.tone: The high end of the family - the lift goes past energy into open cheerfulness, which *stimulating* stops short of.

stimulating.oewn-01360190-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

stimulating.oewn-01360190-s.tone: Cooler than *exhilarating* for the same effect, naming the rousing of liveliness and good cheer without saying how high it rises.

life-giving.oewn-01360332-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

life-giving.oewn-01360332-s.tone: The most absolute claim available here, since what it grants is life and spirit outright rather than a boost to either.

vitalizing.oewn-01360332-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

vitalizing.oewn-01360332-s.tone: The same gift of life and spirit as *life-giving*, stated as a working effect rather than as the grand attribute.

renewing.oewn-01360590-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

renewing.oewn-01360590-s.tone: Approval for a lift that is a return of something lost - new life and vigor given back, not given for the first time as in *life-giving*.

restorative.oewn-01360590-s.label: positive

family.axis: a passing freshening → the imparting of life itself

restorative.oewn-01360590-s.tone: Names the same power of return as a settled property of the thing, calmer and more formal than the active *renewing*.

lively.oewn-00808265-a.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

lively.oewn-00808265-a.tone: The plain measure of the family — life and energy stated without a metaphor attached, so every other member here is a way of colouring it.

alive.oewn-00808685-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

alive.oewn-00808685-s.tone: Credits life and spirit rather than motion, and leans on a following 'with' to name whatever the thing is brimming over with.

bouncing.oewn-00808879-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

bouncing.oewn-00808879-s.tone: Liveliness as vigorous springing action — sturdier and more robust than *bouncy*, which makes the same spring sound weightless.

bouncy.oewn-00808879-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

bouncy.oewn-00808879-s.tone: The spring taken as a temperament rather than a feat — lighter and more playful than *bouncing*.

peppy.oewn-00808879-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

peppy.oewn-00808879-s.tone: Informal and brisk — lively action as a snap of energy, with none of the dignity *spirited* carries.

spirited.oewn-00808879-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

spirited.oewn-00808879-s.tone: The dignified member: lively action with mettle and will behind it, where *peppy* is only pep.

zippy.oewn-00808879-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

zippy.oewn-00808879-s.tone: Informal, and here the lively action is speed — quickness rather than the buoyancy of *bouncy*.

breezy.oewn-00809136-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

breezy.oewn-00809136-s.tone: Puts freshness beside the animation, so the liveliness comes across as light and easy where *spirited* comes across as strong.

bubbly.oewn-00809246-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

bubbly.oewn-00809246-s.tone: Covers both being full of high spirits and showing them, naming the outward fizz and the inward supply at once.

bubbling.oewn-00809380-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

bubbling.oewn-00809380-s.tone: High spirits or excitement caught in the act of rising — a thing in motion where *bubbly* names a settled quality.

effervescent.oewn-00809380-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

effervescent.oewn-00809380-s.tone: The polished word for the same fizz — high spirits or excitement described with a formality the shorter members refuse.

frothy.oewn-00809380-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

frothy.oewn-00809380-s.tone: The weakest approval of the fizz: the high spirits or excitement are granted, but froth lets them look light and easily dispersed.

scintillating.oewn-00809380-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

scintillating.oewn-00809380-s.tone: The brightest of the set — high spirits or excitement that flash and dazzle rather than merely bubble.

sparkly.oewn-00809380-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

sparkly.oewn-00809380-s.tone: The same flash in a smaller, prettier register — decorative where *scintillating* is dazzling.

burbling.oewn-00809634-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

burbling.oewn-00809634-s.tone: Moves the fizz into the voice: enthusiasm uttered with nothing holding it back, warm but with an ear on the overflow.

burbly.oewn-00809634-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain vitality → spirits fizzing over into speech

burbly.oewn-00809634-s.tone: Names the quality of that unrestrained enthusiasm rather than a burst of it — looser and more casual than *burbling*.
